what: the whole-corpus searches F019's absence claims rest on, over the 213 decompiled scripts of run pro-r1 (read in place in the static folder; nothing kept but this record: names, counts and booleans only, no code). Search terms are described in words; each is re-runnable with any terminal search over the run's folder.

seed_search.searched: every one of the 213 decompiled scripts, case-insensitively, for (a) the English word for a seed and (b) the name of Director's random-seed property
seed_search.reads: no handler sets, reads, stores or displays any seed; no seed field exists in any of the three files the game keeps (Q-RND-01)

random_census.searched: every decompiled script for the name of Director's random-value built-in, as a whole word
random_census.reads: one stream at the Lingo level: every draw goes through the same built-in, whose name has no other occurrence in the corpus, and no script names the runtime's seeding property (the seed search)

file_io_census.searched: every decompiled script for the names of Director's file xtra calls (open, create, read, write)

per_script.handles: presence scan of the game folder and its data subfolder; creates the defaults, scores or registration file when missing
the scores file (writes, through the scores reader and the cipher pair)
the scores file (writes zeros, the scores screen's reset button)

file_io_census.reads: no handler opens any other file; no save, load, export or import exists anywhere in the corpus (Q-SET-05, Q-SET-06)

reader_censuses.searched: every decompiled script for each option value's name (whole word); every match read and classified as a reader or not

speed.reads: display (two identical frames), the option button, the delay helpers (each waits a multiple of the value), two animation-repeat loops in the placement handler, and the defaults load/save; no rule code reads it

starting_armies.reads: display, option button, defaults load/save, and the deal's per-country draw (F018's list, re-confirmed)

event_frequency.reads: display, option button, defaults load/save, and the event frame's chance (F015/T23's reader)

seat_table.reads: 20 scripts name the table in all: 12 read it (the two event/end frames' checks, the computer turn frame's dispatch, both display frames, the defaults forcing and validation, the end screen's win routing, the new-game credit check, the two toggles, the deal's copy and fill, the turn dispatch, the income's seat checks) and 8 declare it without using it; the only writers are the defaults forcing and the two toggles (F018's writer search, re-confirmed)

registration_flag.reads: 18 scripts name the flag: 17 branch on it (the option locks, the seat toggles, the scores cap and its notice, the reset button's hover images, the title and quit/exit screen routing, the checker, the entry handler, the entry key-watcher trigger, the title screen's registration line, the forcing, the startup tamper value) and 1 (the scores reset button) declares it without testing it; every gate F019 lists is among them, and no script outside the 18 tests registration

menu_walk.searched: every handler reachable from the bottom menu and the screens it opens, read in full; each names what it opens or does
menu_walk.reads: no save, load, export or import control exists in any menu (Q-SET-05, Q-SET-06)
